policy.limits: No mixed/uniform-nonunit DPI conversion, straddling-window inference, forged-origin authentication or general HDR/display calibration support is claimed.

checks.name: Complete authoritative saved current-browser case selects DISPLAY6/1270 instead of foreground DISPLAY5/700

geometry.qualification: Corroborated trusted snapshot, not authentication against a self-consistent forged browser/native report

checks.name: Foreground/friendly-name changes cannot redirect auto; genuine primary geometry can select DISPLAY5
Explicit native device and manual luminance intent remain incumbent choices even with invalid geometry
Mixed, uniform nonunit, missing native scale and page/pinch zoom reject geometry without foreground fallback
One-sided zero-origin spoof, missing origin, straddling and offscreen windows all reject

evidence.qualification: Cannot authenticate an entirely self-consistent forged snapshot; trusted live property acquisition is required

checks.name: Available work area is not silently used as full-screen origin; explicit full origin retains legitimate taskbar offset
Overlapping/cloned native bounds and duplicate native identities cannot produce an auto selection
Closed browser/options descriptors reject getters, hidden/inherited fields and caller reliability flags without invoking getters
Input snapshots stay byte-identical and output geometry has independent ownership; no hidden I/O

limits: This admits only exact current all-unit-scale native geometry with unit browserDPR and a fully contained window; it is not general mixedDPI or zoom support.
Matches saved trusted observations; no live browser selection, HDR presentation or physical nit measurement occurred here.
Self-consistent forged browser/native snapshots cannot be detected by a pure legacy geometry resolver.

An unreliable multi-display geometry produces explicit ambiguous calibration without foreground fallback; explicit native device selection and existing single-display/manual luminance behavior are retained.
